app_meta._: Key/value store for app-level metadata (schema_version, taxonomy_release, catalog_release, db_key_created_at — never key material).
app_meta.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
app_meta.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL

session_types._: Kinds of training session (Gi class, No-gi class, Open mat, …); seeded catalog, user-extensible.
session_types.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
session_types.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
session_types.source: Seed source: 'grapplemap', 'grapple-flows' or 'curated'; null only for origin = 'user'
session_types.source_id: Stable id inside the source (GrappleMap: gm:<record index>; curated: cur:<slug>; grapple-flows: their slug); null for user rows
session_types.source_version: Release of the source: '2023-02-06' for GrappleMap, the vendored commit date for grapple-flows, the curated release otherwise
session_types.user_edited_at: ISO-8601 UTC time the user last edited an imported field; set ⇒ re-import skips the row (user edits win, R-23)
session_types.name: Display name, unique among live rows (case-insensitive)

positions._: Position nodes of the taxonomy graph (GrappleMap positions plus curated canonical names); a session focus of kind POSITION refers here.
positions.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
positions.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
positions.source: Seed source: 'grapplemap', 'grapple-flows' or 'curated'; null only for origin = 'user'
positions.source_id: Stable id inside the source (GrappleMap: gm:<record index>; curated: cur:<slug>; grapple-flows: their slug); null for user rows
positions.source_version: Release of the source: '2023-02-06' for GrappleMap, the vendored commit date for grapple-flows, the curated release otherwise
positions.user_edited_at: ISO-8601 UTC time the user last edited an imported field; set ⇒ re-import skips the row (user edits win, R-23)
positions.slug: URL-safe kebab-case name, unique among live rows
positions.description: Imported or curated description; null when none
positions.notes: User notes; never touched by a re-import
positions.parent_position_id: Parent position for variants (e.g. Closed guard → Guard); null at the top; never itself
positions.tier: 'CORE' (curated core, shown by default) or 'EXTENDED' (shown only with library.showExtended)

techniques._: Techniques: typed edges between positions; a SUBMISSION has no target position.
techniques.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
techniques.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
techniques.source: Seed source: 'grapplemap', 'grapple-flows' or 'curated'; null only for origin = 'user'
techniques.source_id: Stable id inside the source (GrappleMap: gm:<record index>; curated: cur:<slug>; grapple-flows: their slug); null for user rows
techniques.source_version: Release of the source: '2023-02-06' for GrappleMap, the vendored commit date for grapple-flows, the curated release otherwise
techniques.user_edited_at: ISO-8601 UTC time the user last edited an imported field; set ⇒ re-import skips the row (user edits win, R-23)
techniques.slug: URL-safe kebab-case name, unique among live rows
techniques.name: Display name
techniques.to_position_id: Position it ends in; null if and only if type = SUBMISSION
techniques.perspective: Who performs it: 'TOP' or 'BOTTOM' (GrappleMap properties); null when unknown
techniques.description: Imported or curated description; null when none
techniques.notes: User notes; never touched by a re-import

aliases._: Alternative names of positions and techniques; searched by every picker.
aliases.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
aliases.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
aliases.source: Seed source: 'grapplemap', 'grapple-flows' or 'curated'; null only for origin = 'user'
aliases.source_id: Stable id inside the source (GrappleMap: gm:<record index>; curated: cur:<slug>; grapple-flows: their slug); null for user rows
aliases.source_version: Release of the source: '2023-02-06' for GrappleMap, the vendored commit date for grapple-flows, the curated release otherwise
aliases.user_edited_at: ISO-8601 UTC time the user last edited an imported field; set ⇒ re-import skips the row (user edits win, R-23)
aliases.target_id: Id of the position or technique (polymorphic, no SQL FK)
aliases.name: Alias text; unique per target among live rows (case-insensitive)

subjects._: Non-positional training subjects (e.g. Grip fighting, Guard retention); a session focus of kind SUBJECT refers here.
subjects.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
subjects.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
subjects.source: Seed source: 'grapplemap', 'grapple-flows' or 'curated'; null only for origin = 'user'
subjects.source_id: Stable id inside the source (GrappleMap: gm:<record index>; curated: cur:<slug>; grapple-flows: their slug); null for user rows
subjects.source_version: Release of the source: '2023-02-06' for GrappleMap, the vendored commit date for grapple-flows, the curated release otherwise
subjects.user_edited_at: ISO-8601 UTC time the user last edited an imported field; set ⇒ re-import skips the row (user edits win, R-23)
subjects.name: Display name, unique among live rows (case-insensitive)

cycles._: Training cycles: a date range with 1–3 focuses (UI in sprint 3).
cycles.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
cycles.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
cycles.name: Optional cycle name
cycles.ends_on: Last day, local date YYYY-MM-DD; after starts_on

cycle_focuses._: Focuses of a cycle, as {kind, ref}.
cycle_focuses.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
cycle_focuses.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
cycle_focuses.focus_ref_id: Id of the position or subject (polymorphic, no SQL FK)

slots._: Weekly recurring training slots that generate PLANNED sessions (UI in sprint 3).
slots.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
slots.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
slots.duration_minutes: Planned duration in minutes, > 0; null when unknown
slots.use_cycle_focuses: 1 = generated sessions take the active cycle focuses; 0 = none
slots.paused_at: ISO-8601 UTC time the slot was paused; null while active

sessions._: Training sessions: planned, completed (logged) or skipped. Personal data.
sessions.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
sessions.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
sessions.local_date: Local calendar date YYYY-MM-DD of starts_at in the device zone at write time (ADR 0016)
sessions.duration_minutes: Duration in minutes, > 0; null when not given
sessions.rating: Overall session rating 1–5; null when not given
sessions.intensity: Perceived intensity 1–5; null when not given
sessions.energy: Energy level 1–5; null when not given
sessions.cycle_id: Cycle the session belongs to; null when none
sessions.slot_id: Slot that generated the session; null when created by hand
sessions.completed_at: ISO-8601 UTC time the session was logged; required when status = COMPLETED
sessions.reviewed_at: ISO-8601 UTC time of the first later edit of rating / what_worked / what_failed

session_focuses._: Focuses of a session as {kind, ref}, planned and/or actually trained, with per-focus feedback.
session_focuses.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
session_focuses.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
session_focuses.focus_ref_id: Id of the position or subject (polymorphic, no SQL FK, ADR 0014)
session_focuses.is_actual: 1 = actually trained; planned rows left un-ticked stay 0 (gap signal)
session_focuses.needs_work: 1 = flagged as needing work; only on actual rows
session_focuses.rating: Focus rating 1–5; only on actual rows
session_focuses.hit_count: Times the user hit it, ≥ 0; only on actual rows
session_focuses.caught_count: Times the user got caught in it, ≥ 0; only on actual rows

session_techniques._: Techniques practised in a session, optionally under one of its actual focuses.
session_techniques.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
session_techniques.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
session_techniques.session_focus_id: Focus row of the same session it belongs to (must be actual); null = session-level

rounds._: Detailed sparring rounds of a session (UI in sprint 3).
rounds.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
rounds.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
rounds.round_no: Round number ≥ 1, unique per session among live rows
rounds.partner_belt: Partner belt: one of WHITE BLUE PURPLE BROWN BLACK GREY_WHITE GREY GREY_BLACK YELLOW_WHITE YELLOW YELLOW_BLACK ORANGE_WHITE ORANGE ORANGE_BLACK GREEN_WHITE GREEN GREEN_BLACK; null when unknown
rounds.duration_minutes: Round length in minutes, > 0; null when not given

submissions._: Submissions landed or conceded, per session or per round.
submissions.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
submissions.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
submissions.round_id: Round of the same session; null = logged at session level (R-06)
submissions.technique_id: Submission technique; null when not given

rank_entries._: Belt rank history; the current rank is the latest live entry by awarded_on.
rank_entries.id: UUID v4, generated on device by the repository (expo-crypto randomUUID)
rank_entries.deleted_at: ISO-8601 UTC soft-delete time, null while live; reads filter deleted_at IS NULL
rank_entries.belt: Belt: one of WHITE BLUE PURPLE BROWN BLACK GREY_WHITE GREY GREY_BLACK YELLOW_WHITE YELLOW YELLOW_BLACK ORANGE_WHITE ORANGE ORANGE_BLACK GREEN_WHITE GREEN GREEN_BLACK (valid for the scale)
rank_entries.awarded_on: Local date YYYY-MM-DD the rank was awarded
